question: Netaji Subhash National Institute of Sports is located in which of the following cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patiala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Netaji Subhash National Institute of Sports:**
 
• It was **inaugurated on May 7, 1961**, to mark the beginning of the nation's transition to methodical and scientific sports coaching.
 
• It is **located in Patiala, Punjab.**
 
• The Institute was **renamed in 1973 as a tribute to Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Indian Institute of Tropical Metrology, Pune**:

 
• It was **approved **as one of the programs **under the Third Five Year Plan **by the Indian government **in February 1962**.
 
• It was founded on 17 November, 1962.
 
• It is located in **Pune, Maharashtra**.
 
• It is **under **the administrative **control of Ministry of Earth Sciences.**

**Central Institute of Fisheries Technology (CIFT):**

 
• It started functioning at in 1957.
 
• It is **located in Kochi, Kerala.**
 
• Its research centers function at:
 
 
• Veraval, Gujarat.
 
• Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• Burla, Orissa.
 
• Calicut, Kerala.
 
• Hoshangabad, MP.
